kurz: Garlic only develops its pungency when it is cut. The finer, the stronger, and the faster it burns.
bild_im_kopf: A seasoning with a volume knob: a whole clove is quiet, crushed is loud.
was_passiert: Only when the cells are destroyed do two separate substances react to form the typical pungent aromas. Heat makes it milder and sweetish; too much heat makes it bitter.
faustregeln: Whole cloves for a mild flavour, crushed for a strong one.
Add it to the pan late.
